kpi_definitions.digitization_pct: Percentage of textual Records of Rights (RoRs) and cadastral maps converted into verified digital databases.
kpi_definitions.active_disputes: Total count of active unresolved land ownership, boundary, or inheritance disputes pending in revenue or civil courts.
kpi_definitions.avg_resolution_time_years: Average duration in years required to adjudicate and formally resolve a disputed land title case.
kpi_definitions.ulpin_coverage_pct: Percentage of total land parcels assigned a unique 14-digit Unique Land Parcel Identification Number (Bhu-Aadhar).
kpi_definitions.acquisition_delay_rate_pct: Percentage of major infrastructure land acquisition projects delayed past statutory SLAs due to litigation or compensation delays.
